channel.title: Hope Journal — Catherine Hope Foundation
channel.description: Stories, explainers and dispatches from the Catherine Hope Foundation.

item.title: When the heat came, so did we
item.description: A response piece from a fierce Chennai summer — buttermilk, shade and the simple dignity of not being forgotten.

item.title: Why we're building a Centre of our own
item.description: For four years the Centre moved from room to room — until a slab fell from the ceiling. Here's what 28 pillars really mean.

item.title: A morning at the Centre
item.description: Tuition, a music class, a warm snack and a library card. An ordinary morning that, for these children, is anything but.
